title: Valve Just Ran OUT of Its $1,349 Steam Machine 😳
description:
Valve just closed the waitlist for its $1,349 Steam Machine — the 2TB model is now out of stock.

In a Steam post on 19 Nov 2026, Valve said more people are on the 2TB waitlist than it can build, so it closed sign-ups and marked it out of stock. The good news: the 512GB model ($1,049, no controller) is now buy-now, with an estimated 3–5 business days delivery (as of 20 Nov). It's a ~6-inch cube with a 6-core AMD Zen 4 CPU, 28-CU RDNA 3 GPU, 16GB DDR5 + 8GB GDDR6 — Valve says over six times the horsepower of Steam Deck. The catch: memory and storage costs keep rising, and Valve says it doesn't yet know how many it can make or at what price. More info in January.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 47/100 → WRECK, unless you want your Steam library on a tiny box today.
